evals.prompt: I have a BPMN file at evals/files/linear-3tasks.bpmn. Can you convert it to FigJam? My board is at https://www.figma.com/board/TESTKEY001/test-board
evals.expected_output: The skill parses the BPMN (1 start event, 3 tasks, 1 end event, 4 sequence flows). The file has no layout section, so it computes a left-to-right layout. It creates a section named 'BPMN: <process name>' to the right of existing content, draws the shapes inside it with the bpmn.io default colors (light green start, white tasks, light red end with a thick border), wires 4 connectors, and calls use_figma with fileKey=TESTKEY001. It reports the element counts at the end.
assertions: The skill extracts fileKey 'TESTKEY001' from the provided FigJam URL before generating any code
The generated JavaScript calls figma.loadFontAsync before setting any text
The generated JavaScript creates a section with figma.createSection() and appends the diagram nodes to it, not to the page
The generated JavaScript does not call remove() on any existing board node
The generated JavaScript includes a ROUNDED_RECTANGLE shape for each of the 3 tasks
The start event shape uses the light green fill #c8e6c9 (r~0.784, g~0.902, b~0.788)
The end event shape uses the light red fill #ffcdd2 (r~1.0, g~0.804, b~0.824) and strokeWeight 4
The task shapes use a white fill (r=1, g=1, b=1)
The generated JavaScript includes 4 createConnector() calls for the 4 sequence flows
The skill calls use_figma with fileKey='TESTKEY001'
The final report states: Tasks: 3, Events: 2 (or Start: 1, End: 1), Flows: 4

evals.prompt: Please import this BPMN into FigJam — https://www.figma.com/board/TESTKEY002/approval-flow. The file is at evals/files/exclusive-gateway.bpmn
evals.expected_output: The skill parses the BPMN (1 start event, 3 tasks, 1 exclusive gateway, 1 end event, 6 sequence flows, 2 of them labelled Yes and No). It draws the gateway as a white DIAMOND with an '×' marker and its name as an external label, labels the Yes/No connectors, and calls use_figma with fileKey=TESTKEY002.
assertions: The skill extracts fileKey 'TESTKEY002' from the FigJam URL
The exclusive gateway is rendered as a DIAMOND shape
The exclusive gateway shape uses a white fill and contains the '×' marker as its text
The gateway name 'Approved?' is placed as an external text label, not inside the diamond
The connector from the gateway to 'Process Approval' is labelled 'Yes'
The connector from the gateway to 'Send Rejection Notice' is labelled 'No'
The generated JavaScript does not call remove() on any existing board node
The skill calls use_figma with fileKey='TESTKEY002'
The final report states Tasks: 3 and Gateways: 1

evals.prompt: I want to visualize this process model in FigJam. File: evals/files/two-pools-message.bpmn. FigJam URL: https://www.figma.com/board/TESTKEY003/support-flow
evals.expected_output: The skill parses two pools (Customer and Support Team) with tasks in each, and 2 message flows (Ticket, Resolution). It renders both pools inside the new section, and draws the message flows as dashed purple connectors. It calls use_figma with fileKey=TESTKEY003 and reports Pools: 2, Message: 2.
assertions: The skill extracts fileKey 'TESTKEY003' from the FigJam URL
The generated JavaScript renders nodes for both the Customer pool and the Support Team pool
Message flows are rendered with a dashed stroke (dashPattern [8, 4])
Message flows use a purple stroke, distinct from the dark sequence-flow stroke
The generated JavaScript does not call remove() on any existing board node
The skill calls use_figma with fileKey='TESTKEY003'
The final report mentions Pools: 2 and Message: 2

evals.prompt: Convert this BPMN to FigJam: evals/files/subprocess-mixed.bpmn. Board URL: https://www.figma.com/board/TESTKEY004/subprocess-test
evals.expected_output: The skill detects one collapsed sub-process (SP_Notify, no child elements) and one expanded sub-process (SP_Review, 4 child elements). The collapsed one is a dashed ROUNDED_RECTANGLE with a '+' marker at its bottom centre. The expanded one is a background rectangle with its label at top left and its children drawn on top. It uses the file's layout coordinates, translated into the section. It calls use_figma with fileKey=TESTKEY004 and reports Subprocesses: 2 (Expanded: 1, Collapsed: 1).
assertions: The skill extracts fileKey 'TESTKEY004' from the FigJam URL
Shape positions come from the file's DI coordinates, offset by the same translation into the section
SP_Notify (collapsed) is rendered as a ROUNDED_RECTANGLE with dashPattern [6, 4]
A plus-marker shape (14×14 ROUNDED_RECTANGLE with '+' text) is appended immediately after SP_Notify
SP_Review (expanded) is rendered with createRectangle(), not createShapeWithText()
SP_Review's label is placed at the top left of the container (about 8px in from the left and 6px down from the top)
SP_Review's background rectangle is appended BEFORE its child task shapes
nodeMap[SP_Review.id] resolves to the background rectangle, so the SF2 and SF3 connectors attach to it
Child tasks T_CheckDocs and T_Validate are rendered as ROUNDED_RECTANGLEs inside SP_Review's bounds
The skill calls use_figma with fileKey='TESTKEY004'
The final report states Subprocesses: 2 (Expanded: 1, Collapsed: 1)

evals.prompt: Render evals/files/linear-3tasks.bpmn into https://www.figma.com/board/TESTKEY005/team-retro. Heads up, the board already has our retro sticky notes on it.
evals.expected_output: The skill leaves the sticky notes alone. It creates a new 'BPMN: <process name>' section to the right of the existing content and draws the diagram inside it. Nothing that already exists on the board is removed or moved.
assertions: The generated JavaScript computes the right edge of the existing page children and places the new section to the right of it
The generated JavaScript does not call remove() on any node, and does not loop over page.children to delete them
All diagram nodes are appended to the new section
The final report says existing board content was left untouched
